evals.prompt: Use Spiral to rewrite this launch note in my LinkedIn style. Make it concise, concrete, and suitable for public posting. Also tell me what Spiral style and channel you used.
evals.expected_output: A public-safe LinkedIn draft plus a Spiral Context section naming workspace/style/channel/source assumptions and avoiding private sample excerpts.
assertions: Output includes Spiral workspace, style, and channel context.
Output does not claim Spiral was used unless MCP or user-provided style evidence is available.

evals.prompt: Help me create a new Spiral style from a mix of newsletter essays, short posts, and a few emails. I want the workflow, the minimum sample set, and privacy checks before I paste anything.
evals.expected_output: A style creation workflow with sample-count guidance, source diversity, reference ingestion options, and explicit privacy/sanitization checks.
assertions: Output recommends representative samples across multiple source types.
Output names Spiral reference paths such as URL, paste text, upload, or read-only connection.
Output includes privacy checks before ingestion.
Output distinguishes style references from Knowledge.

evals.prompt: Spiral is logged in but Codex cannot see any Spiral tools. Debug this without exposing tokens.
evals.expected_output: A troubleshooting sequence using codex mcp get/list, OAuth relogin guidance, fresh-session caveat, and no token or callback URL exposure.
assertions: Output starts with codex mcp get spiral or codex mcp list.
Output mentions a fresh Codex session if tools are not visible.
Output warns against exposing tokens or callback URLs.
